description: TRI: Search Toxic Release Inventory data across facilities in a state or county, for one reporting year or, without year, every available year newest first. Returns facility name and county, TRI facility ID, chemical name, and the one-time / non-routine release quantity; set include_release_breakdown to add routine on-site releases by medium (air, water, land, and underground-injection), at the cost of a slower call. Quantities are in pounds; dioxin and dioxin-like compounds, which TRI has facilities report in grams, are converted and marked with reportedUnit. Use to identify top polluters in an area or build an environmental exposure profile. Use epa_tri_get_facility_releases for detailed release records for a single facility. TRI data lags ~18 months from the current calendar year.

chemical_name.description: Optional filter to restrict results to a specific chemical (partial match, case-insensitive). Commas, apostrophes, brackets, and Greek letters are matched as written, e.g. "4,4'-Methylenedianiline".

county.description: County name to narrow results within the state, e.g. "King". Case-insensitive partial match on the bare name, so a short name can also match a longer one (LAKE matches LAKE OF THE WOODS; check countyName on each record); a trailing "County", "Parish", or "Borough" is dropped before matching. Punctuation is matched as written ("Prince George's").

include_release_breakdown.description: Add routine on-site releases by medium (air, water, land, underground injection) to each record. Costs one extra upstream request, which can add about 20 seconds when EPA has not cached it.

limit.description: Maximum number of release records to return (1–200)

year.description: Reporting year. Omit to search every available year in the state, newest reporting year first, so limit keeps the most recent filings. TRI data lags ~18 months.

name: epa_tri_search_releases

cap.description: The limit that was applied. Present only when truncated.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.
Recovery hint when no releases are found. Absent when releases are returned.

notice.description: Present when a punctuated county or chemical_name filter read its page limit before finding limit matches spelled as given, so more matching records may exist.

releases.description: TRI release records for facilities in the queried state and filters

items.description: TRI release record for a facility-chemical-year combination

chemicalName.description: Chemical name as reported to TRI

countyName.description: County as TRI records the facility's location (e.g. "KING", "CALCASIEU PARISH"). The county filter is a partial match, so a short name can also match a longer one (LAKE matches LAKE OF THE WOODS); check this field to keep only the county you meant.

releasesToAirInLbs.description: On-site routine air releases (fugitive + stack emissions) in pounds, summed across air release types for this submission. Only with include_release_breakdown.

releasesToLandInLbs.description: On-site routine land releases in pounds — landfills, land treatment, surface impoundment, and other on-site disposal, summed for this submission. Only with include_release_breakdown.

releasesToUndergroundInjectionInLbs.description: On-site routine releases via underground injection wells in pounds, summed across injection well classes for this submission. Only with include_release_breakdown.

releasesToWaterInLbs.description: On-site routine releases to surface water in pounds, summed across all reported outfalls for this submission. Only with include_release_breakdown.

reportedUnit.description: Present as "grams" when TRI had the facility report this chemical in grams (dioxin and dioxin-like compounds); its quantities here are converted to pounds (1 lb = 453.59237 g). Absent for chemicals reported in pounds.

totalReleasesInLbs.description: TRI one-time / non-routine release quantity in pounds (spills, accidents) — a distinct TRI category, NOT the sum of the per-medium routine releases below.

shown.description: Number of release records returned. Present only when truncated.

truncated.description: True when the result list was capped at the limit — more records may exist. Absent below the limit.

title: Search TRI Releases by Region
